questions.q: What does "pixel-perfect" mean in the context of a BI Publisher report?
options: The report runs faster than other tools
The report reproduces an exact, precisely specified layout every time it runs, regardless of data volume
The report can only be viewed on high-resolution monitors
The report never needs a template
questions.explain: Pixel-perfect output means the layout — fonts, column widths, placement of required fields — stays exact and consistent every run.

questions.q: What are the two core, deliberately separated parts of every BI Publisher report?
options: A subject area and a dashboard
A data model (where the data comes from) and a template (how it's laid out)
A filter and a prompt
An account group and a Sunburst chart
questions.explain: BI Publisher separates the data model, which defines the query producing XML data, from the template, which defines the visual layout.

questions.q: What format are BI Publisher templates most commonly built in?
options: RTF files edited in Microsoft Word with the Template Builder add-in
Raw HTML only
Financial Reporting Studio grids
OTBI dashboard pages
questions.explain: RTF templates built and edited in Microsoft Word using the BI Publisher Template Builder add-in are the most common layout format.

questions.q: Why would a 1099 tax form be a good candidate for BI Publisher rather than OTBI?
options: OTBI cannot connect to Payables data at all
A 1099 form must match an exact, legally required layout every time, which is exactly the pixel-perfect job BI Publisher is built for
BI Publisher is faster at ad hoc exploration than OTBI
1099 forms have no layout requirements
questions.explain: A legally mandated exact layout is the core use case BI Publisher's data-model-plus-template architecture is designed to serve.

questions.q: What does running a BI Publisher report definition actually do?
options: It only opens the Reports and Analytics catalog
It executes the data model's query, merges the resulting XML with the chosen template, and produces the final output format
It deletes the underlying data model
It converts the report into an OTBI analysis automatically
questions.explain: A report definition ties a data model and a template together; running it executes the query, merges the XML with the template, and generates the final output.
